disorder-name.detail: Pediatric brainstem tumors including diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma (DIPG, ~80%) and focal brainstem tumors (~20%); N=145
disorder-name.supporting_text: "A cohort of 145 pediatric patients with brainstem tumors was studied at Beijing Tiantan Hospital"; "Approximately 20% of brainstem tumors are low-grade neoplasms focused in the midbrain, medulla, or dorsal pontine, while the remaining 80% are characterized by diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma (DIPG)"
